package resp

import (
	_ "embed"
	"testing"
)

// golden is the expected response.
//
//go:embed testdata/golden.json

// A comment between the directive and the variable leaves the directive bound.
var golden string

var (
	unrelated = 1
	//go:embed testdata/grouped.json
	grouped string
)

func TestGolden(t *testing.T) {
	if Response() != golden {
		t.Errorf("response differs from golden %q", golden)
	}
}

func TestGrouped(t *testing.T) {
	if Response() != grouped {
		t.Errorf("response differs from grouped %q", grouped)
	}
}
